content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On sales invoice:new, clicking Save shows a visible validation error each time, and the user then edits the Customer, Due Date, Item Code, Qty and Rate inputs and clicks Save again, with the same error appearing again before the form is left.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, when the Save button fails validation, show the specific message beside the first invalid field (Customer, Due Date, Item Code, Qty or Rate) and move focus to that field, instead of showing only a generic visible error.", "cited_event_ids": ["602", "603:e639", "664", "666:e703", "604", "607:e662", "605", "608:e669"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The error events do not name the failing field or the message text, so the specific invalid field is not identified.", "The events do not show whether the edits between Save attempts resolved or caused the error."]}
